name: EMNLP
full_name: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing（經 ACL Rolling Review 投稿）
summary: 經 ARR 投稿：長文 8 頁、短文 4 頁，審稿雙盲但沒有匿名期；有任何無法查證的參考文獻都可能被 desk reject。

pages.zh: 長文上限 8 頁、短文上限 4 頁（依 ARR 投稿規定）。
pages.quote: Long Papers (8 pages) and Short Papers (4 pages)

pages.zh: 長文與短文投稿都應遵守所有 ARR 投稿規定。
pages.quote: Both long and short paper submissions should follow all of the ARR submission requirements, including:

pages.zh: camera-ready 可多 1 頁（長文最多 9 頁、短文最多 5 頁）以回應審稿意見。
pages.quote: Final versions of accepted papers will be given one additional page of content (up to 9 pages for long papers, up to 5 pages for short papers) to address reviewers’ comments.

anonymity.quote: The reviewing process will continue to be double-blind.

anonymity.zh: 依循 ACL 與 ARR 政策，沒有匿名期的要求。
anonymity.quote: Following the ACL and ARR policies, there is no anonymity period requirement.

anonymity.zh: 作者可以透過 ARR 選擇公開匿名的投稿版本。
anonymity.quote: However, authors will be given the option through ARR to make their anonymized submitted articles publicly visible.

appendix.zh: 官方文件沒有寫到（2026/11/16 擷取版本）

llm.zh: 允許 AI 寫作輔助，但 EMNLP 會對完全由 AI 生成的論文和含幻覺引用的投稿採取行動。
llm.quote: submissions with hallucinated citations, and entirely AI-generated papers (AI writing assistance is permitted). EMNLP will take actions against such submissions

llm.zh: 這類投稿可能被 desk reject，所有相關作者可能無法把論文 commit 到 EMNLP 2026 和 EMNLP 2027。
llm.quote: Such submissions may be desk rejected, and all authors involved in the submission may be ineligible to commit their paper(s) to EMNLP 2026 and EMNLP 2027.

llm.zh: 生成式 AI 的使用請參考 ACL 的 Generative Assistance in Authorship 指引。
llm.quote: Please refer to ACL’s guidelines on Generative Assistance in Authorship.

llm.zh: EMNLP 2026 與 GPTZero 合作，偵測所有投稿中不存在於學術資料庫的參考文獻。
llm.quote: EMNLP 2026 has partnered with GPTZero to detect references that do not exist in academic databases in all submitted papers.

rebuttal.zh: 作者回覆與作者—審稿人討論期間為 2026/7/7～7/13。
rebuttal.quote: Author response and author-reviewer discussion July 7 - July 13, 2026

special.zh: 有任何無法查證的參考文獻都可能被 desk reject，所有相關作者可能無法把論文 commit 到 EMNLP 2026 和 EMNLP 2027。
special.quote: Papers with any unverifiable reference may be desk rejected, and all authors involved in the submission may be ineligible to commit their paper(s) to EMNLP 2026 and EMNLP 2027.

special.zh: 投稿後所有作者都必須在 2026/5/27 AoE 當天結束前填完 author registration form。
special.quote: After submission, all authors must complete the author registration form by May 27, 2026 EoD AoE.

special.zh: ARR 2026 May 投稿時須明確宣告要 commit 到哪個會議，這個選擇對 EMNLP 2026 具約束力。
special.quote: authors will need to explicitly declare which conference they intend to commit to at submission time. This choice will be binding for EMNLP 2026
